impact_assessment.why: Persistent MemoryStore is written every step but never read by Planner; a restart with hidden goal fields truncates (200 steps, 0 reward).
impact_assessment.benefits: Recovery behavior from persistent substrate; planner probe trace shows state/memory/persistent source; ablation kills both.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Planner gains an optional recall source and probe field; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none (single-thread); state: separate layouts table preserves memories count and standing traces.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Separate layouts table with INSERT OR IGNORE; source optional; cache episode-scoped; all standing pins and goldens re-run; failing-first test.

impact_assessment.why: A cold-first run with no prior warm layout writes a stripped state; first-write-wins then keeps it, so a later full run cannot restore recovery.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cold-first then warm then cold recovers; existing incomplete layouts heal; trace shows layout completeness and persistent source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save_layout gains optional replace; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: layouts table unchanged, content replacement only when current is complete and existing is incomplete.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Completeness gate before any write; replace only complete-over-incomplete; executable negative control patches the gate; all cycle 45 pins re-run.
